air.name: Air
air.best_for: Developer-tool / AI-product landing pages and product launches that want a dark, atmospheric, type-driven register — full-bleed hero imagery plus restrained flat UI chrome, similar to Linear/Vercel territory.
air.avoid_for: Content-dense enterprise dashboards, warm or playful consumer brand presentations, long-form editorial pages, or any context that needs light-mode clarity or a single strong CTA color — this system only works as dark, quiet, and image-led.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.tagline: scientific field journal on warm parchment — quiet ivory surfaces, editorial serif headlines, and a single clay accent that only appears when you must act
anthropic.best_for: AI research / deep-tech brand sites, research-publication landing pages, and thoughtful product announcements that want credibility without corporate chill — an authoritative editorial register on warm paper.
anthropic.avoid_for: Fast, playful consumer or startup marketing, conversion-heavy SaaS funnels needing loud CTAs, dark-mode-first products, or any context requiring cool-tone or high-energy visuals — the clay accent must stay rare and quiet.

caldera.name: Caldera
caldera.tagline: forge fire on warm limestone. The canvas is raw warm plaster, and every orange element reads as glowing embers pressed into the surface.
caldera.best_for: Crypto / web3 / protocol ecosystem landing pages and feature announcements that want volcanic urgency with warm credibility — ultrabold condensed type, flat warm surfaces, and one dominant orange, Berachain/Monad territory.
caldera.avoid_for: Data-dense dashboards, formal enterprise or luxury brand decks, text-heavy long-form editorial, or anything needing cool-tone restraint — the 189px type and single-orange palette overwhelm quiet or informational contexts.

composer.name: Composer
composer.best_for: Fintech / trading / devtool marketing pages that want a confident, maximalist editorial manifesto register — poster-scale grotesque headlines on a light ash canvas with Bauhaus color blocks, Stripe/Replit-adjacent.
composer.avoid_for: Quiet luxury or premium brand presentations, long-form reading experiences, dark-mode-first products, or restrained minimal SaaS where loud confetti and 244px type would feel noisy — color here is punctuation, not decoration to add casually.

discover.name: Discover
discover.tagline: Type museum on white marble — a near-black wordmark, a whisper of coral, and everything else recedes.
discover.best_for: Type foundries, font marketplaces, and gallery-like product catalogues where the product itself is typography — a near-monochrome museum register with one coral action color and specimen-first layout.
discover.avoid_for: Content-heavy SaaS dashboards, brand-first storytelling sites needing imagery or illustration, playful consumer brands, or dark-mode products — the 1% colorfulness and white-marble quiet fail when color or content density is required.

flying-papers.name: Flying Papers
flying-papers.best_for: Age-gated creative / editorial microsites, riso-print-style brand statements, and playful anti-corporate campaigns that want to take attention rather than ask for it — one poster per screen, Saturday-morning-cartoon energy.
flying-papers.avoid_for: Formal enterprise, data-dense dashboards, professional SaaS or B2B software pages, or any context needing credibility or quiet restraint — the oversized display type and flat violet stage overwhelm informational content.

frankys.name: FRANKY'S
frankys.tagline: Retro arcade kiosk on a skate-shop counter.
frankys.best_for: E-commerce product pages for streetwear / skate / indie apparel brands that want a retro arcade-kiosk feel — compact cream product grids, pixel type, one orange marquee and one green buy button, Palace/Polar-adjacent.
frankys.avoid_for: Formal enterprise, financial or B2B software, dark-mode products, or any premium/editorial context — the 8-bit single-font system and cream+black binary read toy-like and can't carry subtle or authoritative messaging.

general-intelligence-company.name: General Intelligence Company
general-intelligence-company.best_for: AI research / venture / co-founder-match sites and literary-brand storytelling pages that want a contemplative, journal-like register — hand-painted illustration plus quiet serif display, warm parchment, Stripe/Anthropic-adjacent.
general-intelligence-company.avoid_for: Conversion-hungry SaaS funnels needing loud filled CTAs, dark-mode-first products, playful consumer brands, or data-dense dashboards — the whispered serif, 95%-neutral palette, and one blue border can't carry urgency or high information density.

good-glyphs.name: Good Glyphs
good-glyphs.tagline: oversized charity poster on mint paper — type so large it behaves as architecture, not text.
good-glyphs.best_for: Charity / donation campaigns, creative-collective and type-foundry poster sites where type is the product — an oversized printed-poster register, one mint canvas, one black ink, type-as-architecture, Field Notes / It's Nice That-adjacent.
good-glyphs.avoid_for: Any context needing multiple colors, imagery, or hierarchy beyond type — software dashboards, e-commerce catalogues, corporate sites, or playful multi-color brands; the two-color band system and 288px type leave no room for anything but typography.

henry.name: Henry
henry.tagline: Gothic broadside poster on warm cream paper. One hundred percent monochrome, no chromatic accent, all visual intensity carried by display type and full-bleed paper-to-ink inversions.
henry.best_for: Editorial / creative personal portfolios, studio and magazine-style brand sites where type is the entire visual — a warm monochrome broadside register, display-serif headlines, condensed mastheads, paper-to-ink inversions, Pentagram/Rauno Freiberg-adjacent.
henry.avoid_for: SaaS product marketing, e-commerce, dashboards, or any context needing imagery, product art, or a single CTA color — with no chromatic accent, no filled CTAs, and no shadows, the system can only carry type-first editorial content.

huddle.name: Huddle
huddle.tagline: Pastel inventory cards on cream paper
huddle.best_for: Design-studio / curated project directories, membership and community launch pages, and catalog-style listings that want a quiet editorial register — off-white canvas, large light-weight headlines, and three pastel status cards doing the structural work.
huddle.avoid_for: High-saturation e-commerce marketplaces, data-dense dashboards or analytics products, dark-mode-first interfaces, and any context needing a loud filled CTA — the muted pastels and flat hairline system read as a considered directory, not a promotional storefront.

hyer-aviation.name: Hyer Aviation
hyer-aviation.tagline: Cockpit twilight over parchment. A pale dawn-sky meets a slab-serif logo the size of a fuselage, with one warm clay accent breaking the monochrome restraint.
hyer-aviation.best_for: Luxury aviation / premium travel editorial landing pages and high-end service brands that want near-monochrome architectural confidence — a pale sky hero, a slab-serif wordmark at fuselage scale, and one clay feature card per page.
hyer-aviation.avoid_for: Playful or warm consumer brands, information-dense SaaS dashboards, long-form reading surfaces, and any light-mode-only or single-accent-reliant context — the system needs both the dark-band oscillation and the one-warm-note restraint to work.

ikea.name: IKEA
ikea.best_for: Large consumer retail and e-commerce editorial homepages, product-heavy brand storytelling built around one strong brand color, and flat Scandinavian identities — media-led card grids with a single yellow action plane doing all the interface work.
ikea.avoid_for: Dark-mode-first products, luxury/minimal premium brands where yellow would read as noise, dense data UIs, and any context needing shadow-based depth, multiple accent colors, or more than two font weights.

lamanna.name: Lamanna
lamanna.tagline: Neon circus tent on a Naples sidewalk
lamanna.best_for: Maximalist food and bakery brands, playful local-business landing pages, and loud promotional campaigns that want full-bleed chromatic energy — orange-and-yellow color bands, starburst badges, and circus-tent decoration as the brand.
lamanna.avoid_for: Corporate and financial contexts, calm minimal or premium brands, readable long-form editorial, and any interface needing restrained palettes or quiet UX — the screaming orange canvas and solid-block type overwhelm informational content.

leandra-isler.name: Leandra-isler
leandra-isler.tagline: dried botanicals pressed into warm vellum — calm, tactile, editorial, almost reverent.
leandra-isler.best_for: Healing and wellness practices, single-practitioner editorial sites, galleries, and quiet warm-toned brands wanting a reverent gallery-wall atmosphere — one real plant photograph and vast vellum whitespace doing all the emotional work.
leandra-isler.avoid_for: Dark-mode or technology products, playful multi-color brands, data-dense UIs, and any context needing cards, filled buttons, or pill chips — the interface has no containers, so standard UI chrome reads as alien on the flat vellum.

lpalo.name: Lpalo
lpalo.tagline: A children's storybook spread on warm peach paper — one slab-serif headline shouting through scattered crayon doodles.
lpalo.best_for: Playful podcast and media platforms, children's-content or creative community brands, and expressive landing pages that want an authoritative-voice-childlike-delivery tension — chunky slab-serif headlines shouting over scattered crayon doodles on peach paper.
lpalo.avoid_for: Corporate or enterprise contexts, data-dense dashboards, dark-mode products, and any interface needing neutral grays, shadows, or conventional filled CTAs — the storybook slab-serif and crayon palette overwhelm serious or informational content.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.best_for: Fintech and premium banking landing pages, dark-mode developer tools, and product launches wanting cinematic aspiration — an onyx canvas, graphite cards, intermediate-weight typography, and one cobalt action button as the gravitational center.
mercury.avoid_for: Playful consumer brands, multi-color or light-mode contexts, editorial long-form reading, and any interface needing more than one bright accent or shadow-based depth — the cobalt single-action discipline and hushed premium darkness only work as dark, monochrome, and calm.

monad.name: Monad
monad.tagline: editorial tech journal on warm parchment
monad.best_for: Developer-tool and data-infrastructure landing pages wanting a literary technical register — warm parchment canvas, editorial serif headlines, monospace body, and a data-pipeline diagram as the visual centerpiece.
monad.avoid_for: Consumer retail and playful multi-color brands, image-led hero marketing, and any interface needing bold (600+) headlines, pure-white backgrounds, or sans-serif body text — the serif-mono pairing and warm parchment canvas define the identity, and swapping them breaks it.

monopo-saigon.name: Monopo Saigon
monopo-saigon.tagline: Liquid iridescence behind editorial silence — a monochrome editorial gallery floating on molten light.
monopo-saigon.best_for: Premium design-studio and agency portfolio sites, editorial brand statements, and gallery-style product showcases wanting radical monochrome discipline — a black-and-white editorial gallery floating on one molten iridescent hero.
monopo-saigon.avoid_for: Data-dense or transactional products, playful multi-color consumer brands, and any interface needing chromatic UI fills, shadows, or intermediate border radii — the system jumps straight from sharp 0px to full 75px pill, and the iridescent gradient is media only, never UI color.

motherduck.name: MotherDuck
motherduck.tagline: Crayon-coded terminal on cream paper — a developer tool that refuses to dress like one.
motherduck.best_for: Developer-tool / data-infra landing pages, product launches, technical announcements that want credibility WITHOUT corporate seriousness — a light-canvas, notebook-sketch register that reads playful and confident.
motherduck.avoid_for: Formal enterprise sales decks, luxury/editorial brand presentations, heavy data-dense financial reports, any context needing premium restraint or dark-mode authority.

oryzo-ai.name: ORYZO AI
oryzo-ai.tagline: Darkroom product editorial. A lone object floating in warm darkness, cream typography the only decoration.
oryzo-ai.best_for: Premium hardware and single-product brand sites, studio portfolio reveals, and cinematic product launches that want a museum-artifact atmosphere — one object floating in warm darkness with cream typography as the only decoration.
oryzo-ai.avoid_for: Light-mode SaaS or e-commerce, data-dense interfaces, playful multi-color brands, and any context needing lowercase headings, pure white text, or multiple filled CTAs — the museum-label uppercase voice and warm darkness only work with restraint and full-viewport sections.

patch.name: Patch
patch.best_for: Confident tech/engineering-adjacent agency or B2B service pages (a medical-marketing agency pitched as engineering), launch sites that want a loud blueprint statement — full-bleed indigo hero, aggressive condensed headline, orange CTA, sketch illustration, numbered section markers.
patch.avoid_for: Consumer lifestyle brands, gentle/friendly product pages, dense data dashboards, or any context needing rounded softness or photographic warmth — the aggressive sub-1.0 condensed display, full-bleed electric indigo, and 5px-sharp blueprint geometry dominate everything they touch.

raycast.name: Raycast
raycast.best_for: Developer-tool and power-user productivity landing pages (launcher, automation, keyboard-first apps) that want a dark power-tool cockpit: near-black canvas, hairline borders, inset key-shadow cards, a neutral light-gray CTA, and one cinematic hero artwork.
raycast.avoid_for: Consumer retail, playful multi-color brands, light-mode marketing pages, or any context needing a welcoming or friendly register — the 98% achromatic near-black cockpit, single coral accent, and key-cap card treatment read as a serious power-user product, not a consumer pitch.

seline-analytics.name: Seline Analytics
seline-analytics.tagline: Quiet analyst's desk on warm paper
seline-analytics.best_for: Analytics and B2B SaaS landing pages (analytics, dashboards, developer tools) that want an editorial, quietly confident register — warm stone canvas, one cyan CTA, weight-400 geometric headlines, flat white cards with hairline borders, and a grayscale dashboard mockup as the hero proof.
seline-analytics.avoid_for: Consumer retail, playful multi-color brands, image-led lifestyle marketing, or any context needing loud or emotional display — the whisper-weight headlines, single-cyan restraint, and flat paper surfaces make this a calm analytical voice that struggles with high-energy consumer pitches.

steep.name: Steep
steep.best_for: AI / analytics / data-infrastructure product landing pages that want an editorial, magazine-spread feel — oversized italicized serif headlines on white paper, one peach accent card, pill controls, and floating product UI artifacts (region tables, activation charts, AI composer) instead of a dashboard shell.
steep.avoid_for: Dense operational dashboards, dark-mode products, consumer retail, or any context needing heavy chrome or saturated multi-color surfaces — the editorial serif voice, whisper-thin shadows, 97% achromatic palette, and oversized rounded cards are a magazine-spread register, not a data-dense cockpit.

superhi-plus.name: SuperHi Plus
superhi-plus.tagline: Cobalt blueprint scattered with emoji marbles. The page lives half in electric blue, half in ice white, swapping sides as you scroll.
superhi-plus.best_for: Product/community launch pages and educational-brand sites (a creative school, cohort, or app) that want a bold binary statement — full-bleed cobalt-and-ice split panels swapping sides, one weight-400 neo-grotesque voice at 42–85px, arrow-prefixed navigation, and 3D emoji marbles as personality.
superhi-plus.avoid_for: Data-dense SaaS dashboards, consumer retail, formal corporate sites, or any context needing quiet restraint or multi-color illustration — the full-bleed cobalt-and-ice split, single-weight 400 type, and emoji-marble texture are a bold declarative voice that overwhelms informational density.

superr.name: Superr
superr.tagline: Warm schoolyard notebook in soft afternoon light. A cream page, an orange marker uncapped, and a stack of sticker-laminated name labels waiting to be peeled.
superr.best_for: Consumer product launches and playful D2C brands (notebooks, stationery, lifestyle goods) that want a warm schoolyard feel — cream-paper canvas, hand-marker orange annotations, photographed product objects, chunky lowercase display type, and sticker illustrations scattered like physical peel-and-stick.
superr.avoid_for: Enterprise SaaS dashboards, dark-mode products, formal corporate reports, or any context needing neutral data-density or a screen-white canvas — the cream-paper, marker-orange, sticker-and-notebook vocabulary is a warm, tactile, slightly mischievous register that fights neutral professionalism.

syllabus.name: Syllabus
syllabus.tagline: cream-paper magazine meets geometric sans-serif. Warm off-white surfaces, near-black violet ink, and one buttery yellow accent that functions as the page's only raised voice — like a sticky note pressed onto fine stationery.
syllabus.best_for: Editorial-tech product landing pages (premium SaaS, waitlists, developer-adjacent launches) that want a print-magazine feel — warm cream paper canvas, near-black violet ink, oversized geometric headlines, sharp 0px corners, one buttery-yellow hard-shadow CTA, and flat line-art illustrations.
syllabus.avoid_for: Dark-mode products, dense operational dashboards, consumer retail with heavy photography, or any context needing soft rounded corners or screen-white purity — the sharp-cornered 0px-radius geometry, cream canvas, and hard-offset sticker CTA are a distinctive premium print-magazine voice that resists neutral SaaS conventions.

ventriloc.name: Ventriloc
ventriloc.tagline: Editorial data observatory on warm paper — a single orange ember punctuating monochrome precision.
ventriloc.best_for: Data-product and analytics SaaS landing pages (observability, finance dashboards, B2B data platforms) that want an editorial observatory feel — warm paper-white canvas, monospaced-precision data cards, a single orange ember as highlight, weight-400 PolySans headlines, and chart widgets as the imagery.
ventriloc.avoid_for: Consumer retail, playful multi-color brands, loud startup launches, or any context needing bold or emotional typography — the whisper-weight PolySans, 95% achromatic restraint, asymmetric cut-corner cards, and generous whitespace are a quiet editorial voice that reads like a printed annual report, not a hype page.

wispr-flow.name: Wispr Flow
wispr-flow.best_for: AI / productivity / speech-to-text software landing pages (dictation, writing tools, typing apps) that want an editorial broadsheet feel — cream and dark-velvet chambers, weight-400 EB Garamond display at 48–120px, oversized rounded corners, a soft lavender CTA, and waveform visualizers as signature graphics.
wispr-flow.avoid_for: Dense operational dashboards, formal corporate sites, consumer retail with heavy photography, or any context needing sharp corners or screen-pure white — the cream broadsheet, 2px ink borders, oversized rounded chambers, and lavender CTA are a warm editorial voice that reads like a printed magazine rebuilt for software, not a neutral B2B page.
